entities.name: Query Nnr protein
observations: 507 aa protein; estimated molecular mass 54.43 kDa and theoretical pI 5.14.
Best reviewed homologs are bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes with 33.7–36.1% identity, 97.3–98.6% coverage, and E-values of 2.74e-78 to 4.15e-93.
Pfam domains: YjeF_N (PF03853) at residues 32–194 and Carb_kinase (PF01256) at residues 255–495.
Likely catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of S-NAD(P)HX; exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs.
Reviewed homologs bind one K+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: B5YIM0
observations: Reviewed Thermodesulfovibrio yellowstonii Nnr homolog annotated with EC 4.2.1.136 and EC 5.1.99.6.
Catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration, producing AMP and phosphate while repairing NAD(P)H or NAD(P)H-related hydrates.
